```{r}
library(anndataR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(slingshot)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
adata <- read_h5ad("2_car_only_annotated_v2.h5ad", as = "SingleCellExperiment")
adata
```

```{r}
dimred <- reducedDim(adata, "X_umap")
clustering <- adata$labels
counts <- assay(adata, "counts")
```

```{r}
set.seed(61)
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = counts)
)

reducedDim(sce, "UMAP") <- dimred
colData(sce)$labels <- clustering

sce <- slingshot(
  sce,
  clusterLabels = "labels",
  reducedDim = "UMAP",
  start.clus = "Product Mixed T"
)
```

### summary of results
```{r}
SlingshotDataSet(sce)
```

### save object to not have to run again
```{r}
saveRDS(sce, file = "car_only/car_slingshot_object.rds")
```

```{r}
palette <- ggsci::pal_d3("category20")(20)

# Create a color lookup table
cluster_cols <- setNames(
  palette[seq_along(levels(clustering))],
  levels(clustering)
)

# Assign a color to each cell based on its cluster
cell_cols <- cluster_cols[as.character(clustering)]
```

```{r}
mst <- slingMST(sce)

nodes <- data.frame(
  cluster = V(mst)$name,
  do.call(rbind, vertex_attr(mst, "coordinates"))
)

colnames(nodes)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

nodes
```

```{r}
edge_list <- as.data.frame(get.edgelist(mst))

colnames(edge_list) <- c("from", "to")
```

```{r}
edges <- edge_list %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(xend = UMAP_1, yend = UMAP_2)

edges
```

```{r}
cell_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,1],
  UMAP_2 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,2],
  labels = sce$labels
)

p <- ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = labels), size = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = xend,
      yend = yend
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    geom_point(
    data = nodes,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  theme_classic()
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "car_only/pseudotime_MST_umap.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```
